body:
Build an unattended path from official Repo2RLEnv PR candidates to reproducible, independently controlled task bundles, preserving original grading without per-task human/LLM repairs.

**Implementation:** [PR #46](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/46) supplies validation. Draft [PR #50](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/50) adds installed source/discovery/manifest generation and handoff, with 105 passing tests, green GitHub checks and an actual installed archived-source/export/SDK proof. Both are open/unmerged. [Results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/8053eb2c/experiments/48-generation-manifest/installed-results.md). Fresh native execution through this installed path remains unproven; no extra model call/job/spend was used for extraction.

**Scientific findings:** #45 generated one known Cobrapy PR #1497 package with 11 original calls/$0.287646, followed by an APT reconstruction failure. #47’s explicit generic policy recovered builds but original 300-second controls timed out; null rewards disagree with late files. #49 preserved that evidence, verified anonymous readback and cleaned owned resources without accepting/regrading it. All owned jobs are terminal. No independently accepted fresh pair or clean command is established.

**Next:** actual subissue #51 generalizes held-native retention/cleanup, reusing the archived negative evidence and existing code. Initial work is offline; no native/model admission. #48/#50 remain open for review and meaningful future native evidence. Do not regenerate known references merely to test an interface.

**Coverage/budget:** original #28 stays at 83 exports, 82 ever-positive, 67 ever-clean; 25 public-eligible and 58 Matchms withheld. A reproduced package is not a new unique task. Epic actual is 9.596001/32 CPUh, zero CPU reservations, $0.287646 provider cost and $10 existing archival reserve unreconciled. Operating ceiling $90, strictly below $100 extra; no new capacity.

Keep #28 closed and epic/children open for review. Concise status here, detailed logs/eligible append-only HF receipts in comments. Retain protected evidence/research branches. No automatic merge or dataset release.
